title: Degree-zero descent for the categorical Cech augmentation
statement: theorem sheaf_cech_augmentation_quasiIsoAt_zero {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasFiniteWidePullbacks C] (I : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (X : C) {ι : Type v} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) (e : (CochainComplex.single₀ AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj (I.obj.obj (op X)) ⟶ (cechComplexFunctor (fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i))).obj ((Over.forget X).op ⋙ I.obj)) (he : ∀ t : Fin 1 → ι, e.f 0 ≫ Pi.π (fun s : Fin 1 → ι ↦ I.obj.obj (op (∏ᶜ (fun k ↦ Over.mk (π (s k)))).left)) t = I.obj.map (∏ᶜ (fun k ↦ Over.mk (π (t k)))).hom.op) : QuasiIsoAt e 0

proof.text: Use Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext_ofArrows and the component hypothesis he, pulled back along singleton product diagonals, to prove that e.f 0 is monic. Reduce the degree-zero quasi-isomorphism to invertibility of its lift to zero cycles with CochainComplex.quasiIsoAt₀_iff and ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_isIso_liftCycles.
Apply categorical zero-cocycle compatibility to the universal cycle inclusion. The extracted local morphisms form a compatible family.

Apply the proved Mathlib sheaf amalgamateOfArrows to this family. Its restriction equations, he, and the inverse singleton projection identities prove g e.f 0 equals the cycle inclusion. Kernel inclusion cancellation gives g f = id for the cycle lift f; monicity of f gives f g = id. These equations construct IsIso f.
